description:
`loop.ex:209` — run_parallel uses
`max_concurrency: max(length(tool_calls), 1)`. A model returning
50 parallel tool calls (rare but possible) spawns 50 tasks. Cap
to a sensible limit (e.g. 16) so a pathological batch can't blow
up the scheduler.

TDD:
- Test: 20 tool calls with a 2-tool-cap still executes all 20.
- Timing test (existing 2-tool parallel) should still pass
  unchanged.
title: Cap max_concurrency for parallel tool dispatch
